Interface WritableFileEntry

All Superinterfaces:
Container, FileEntry
All Known Implementing Classes:
DiskFileStoreAdapter.DiskFileEntryAdapter, GamedosFileEntry, ZipFileEntry
public interface WritableFileEntry extends FileEntry, Container
A WritableFileEntry represents a single, writable file on disk.
